# JTN Printable

> Original printable gallery-wall collections. Digital downloads only; no physical prints or frames are shipped.

## Collections
- [Coastal Cottage Wall Art](https://slapglif.github.io/jtnprintable-site/coastal-cottage-wall-art/): coastal cottage, beach house, and lake house printable wall art.
- [Tropical Aquarium Wall Art](https://slapglif.github.io/jtnprintable-site/tropical-aquarium-wall-art/): tropical fish and coral reef printable wall art.
- [Up North Cottage Printable Wall Art](https://slapglif.github.io/jtnprintable-site/up-north-cottage-printable-wall-art/): cottage, cabin, and lake-house printable decor.
- [Beach House Bathroom Wall Art](https://slapglif.github.io/jtnprintable-site/beach-house-bathroom-wall-art/): tropical aquarium printable bathroom decor.

## Help
- [Digital Download Help](https://slapglif.github.io/jtnprintable-site/digital-download-help/)

Etsy listing CTAs on each page use unique organic UTM links. Etsy handles checkout and file delivery.
